name: nyquest
description: Nyquest Context Manager: keeps large tool results out of Claude's context. Parks them locally, leaves an exact-line digest, and lets Claude recall precise slices on demand.

api_key.title: Nyquest API key (optional)
api_key.description: Turns on full mode: platform condensation for web and agent prose, recall(ask=...) answers and account savings totals. Free at app.nyquest.ai; it starts with nq-v1-. Leave it empty for local mode, in which the plugin sends nothing to Nyquest.
